description: AI (transcription) credit spend (GET /v1/usage/ai) over a range, optionally grouped by day, track, or collection. spend_units are ledger units (1 unit = $0.0001 USD); spend_usd is the formatted amount. Requires a full API Access key. Requires AudioDN OAuth sign-in (call adn_sign_in or complete account login first).
name: adn_get_ai_spend
